title: Delegated Privileges & Onboarding Route for Enterprise Admin Requests
creator: Aisha Nayar
description: Design a standardized intake and decision workflow for enterprise admin and access requests that involve delegated privileges (role delegation, temporary elevated access), onboarding flows for privileged users, and cross-tenant org policies. This ticket captures: a scoring rubric to prioritize requests, a lightweight decision tree for self-serve vs manual review, required artifacts for submission, and operational handoffs needed for Dedicated/Private customers. Goal: reduce avg triage time for high-impact admin requests to <72 hours and provide deterministic routing to PM/SEC/ENG owners.
acceptance_criteria: A clear intake form template (fields enumerated) used by Support and CSMs
A numeric triage score with thresholds for immediate approval, expedited engineering review, and multi-team manual review
Decision tree that maps request types (RBAC role change, SSO config change, SCIM provisioning change, org policy exception) to routing (Support -> CSM -> Security -> Eng) and SLAs
Documentation page in Confluence linked from support ticket with required artifacts and sample answers
Pilot with two enterprise customers (one Dedicated, one Hosted) completed and measured against triage SLA goals
Handoff checklist for engineering work (migration plan, audit log requirements, release gating) created
triage_rubric: Factors considered: customer_tier (enterprise/dedicated), ARR_at_risk, regulatory_constraint (e.g., GDPR/FINRA), security_risk (privilege_scope and blast_radius), implementation_effort_estimate (small/medium/large), operational_footprint (ongoing overrides/monitoring), and urgency (business_blocker/normal)

Scoring: customer_tier: enterprise=3, dedicated=2, self-serve=0; ARR_at_risk: >$1M=4, $250k-1M=2, <250k=0; regulatory_constraint: yes=3, no=0; security_risk: high=4, medium=2, low=0; effort: large=-2, medium=-1, small=0; operational_footprint: ongoing= -2; urgency: business_blocker= +3; total score maps to routing: >=8 -> Security+Eng priority review, 5-7 -> Product & CSM review, 2-4 -> Support-led & template response, <=1 -> self-serve guidance

Example: RBAC role delegation to create cross-team service accounts for Dedicated customer with ARR $2.5M, regulatory constraint=false, security_risk=high, effort=medium => score = 2 (tier)+4 (ARR)+0 (reg)+4 (sec)+(-1 effort) = 9 -> escalates to Sec+Eng priority review
proposed_flow: 1) Intake: Support/CSM uses standardized form linked to ticket with required artifacts: org_id, contact, existing role mappings, justification, start/end for temporary elevation, risk mitigation plan, and audit requirements
2) Automated pre-check: system calculates triage score using rubric and attaches recommended routing and SLA to ticket
3) If score >=8: route to Security + Engineering on-call with 48h target response and create a secure Slack channel; schedule 1-hour triage call if unclear
4) If score 5-7: PM + CSM triage; PM decides whether to scope a small change or to create an eng request for prioritized backlog
5) If score 2-4: Support implements documented self-serve steps or provides configuration guide and closes with follow-up in 5 business days
6) Post-action: update ticket with outcome, include audit log export, update knowledge base with new FAQ if pattern emerges
7) Monthly review: CS/PM/SEC rotation reviews all escalations to identify policy/UX fixes to lower future triage burden
